title: Prakriti Self-Assessment
instructions: Answer for your LIFELONG, constitutional tendencies — not how you feel today. Pick the option that has described you for most of your life.

_provenance.note: The reference questionnaire image was not machine-readable at build time. These 20 questions follow the standard classical Prakriti attribute set (body frame, skin, hair, eyes, appetite, digestion, sleep, memory, temperament, climate preference, etc.) used across standard dosha-assessment instruments. Replace or re-word items here to match your exact questionnaire — the format and scoring engine support drop-in updates. Do not treat this version as a verified transcription of your source document.
_provenance.confidence: High for trait structure; exact wording must be verified against your source.
